messages:
jake (Support): FYI Acme reported failing JSON-mode responses from /v1/generate with response_format=json&strict=true. Their parser throws on invalid JSON. Please triage.

emma (Support): Thanks Jake — Liz from Acme is on the thread, she sent a curl and response. Liz, can you paste the failing payload + resp id?

liz (Acme): pasted example below. Happening intermittently since ~2025-03-10 12:34 PST. Req-ID: rq_0a1b2c3d. We set Content-Type: application/json.

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"prompt":"generate json","response_format":"json","strict":true}'

Response (truncated):
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
{
  "result": {"items": [ {"id": 1, "name": "foo"}, ], "count": 1}
}

Parser error: Trailing comma at line 3.

jake (Support): Ok that looks like an extra trailing comma inside the array. Do you have the full raw body? Any streaming indicated (SSE)?

liz (Acme): We don't use streaming. This is non-streaming request. We saw it ~5x in last 24h, otherwise fine. Full body above is the server response received.

emma (Support): Adding @xia and @omar to investigate model/runtime emission vs post-processing. Also creating INC-2025-487.

support-bot: Incident INC-2025-487 created and linked to customer Acme (P2).

xia (eng-runtime): Looking. Two quick hypotheses: 1) partial chunking leftover from streaming fallback left a trailing comma when model appended list items, or 2) our strict JSON post-processor was bypassed for responses > 32kB during last week's rollout. Any correlation id examples?

liz (Acme): rq_0a1b2c3d (same as above) and rq_7f8e9d0c. Both non-streaming and small (<8kB).

omar (eng-ml): From model side: some open models produce "explanatory text" appended after JSON (e.g., "Note: this is best-effort") which makes output non-JSON. But that would be extra text, not trailing commas. Could be the model closing tokens include punctuation that our emitter writes incorrectly.

xia (eng-runtime): Thanks. I pulled logs for rq_0a1b2c3d: runtime accepted non-streaming, used model variant rwd-open-2.1, kernel path v1.2.3. Generator chunks were emitted in 3 tokens groups; final flush appended close-brace but an extra comma token was present in the token stream before close. Looks like a tokenization/serialization mismatch in our JSON-mode wrapper for that model when quantized kernels are used.

jake (Support): So root cause = serializer bug when using that model + kernel combo. Any quick mitigations for the customer?

xia (eng-runtime): Short-term mitigation: ask customer to set header X-Redwood-Json-Mode: permissive which will wrap the body in a top-level object "raw" if parsing fails. Alternatively, they can set Accept: application/json and our proxy will attempt to post-process to valid JSON by removing trailing commas — we can enable that for Acme as a temporary feature-flag.

omar (eng-ml): Also suggest forcing model variant rwd-open-2.0 for their account until we push a runtime fix. That variant doesn't exercise the buggy kernel path.

emma (Support): Liz — would you like us to enable the permissive wrapper for Acme now and pin to rwd-open-2.0 while we fix?

liz (Acme): Please enable wrapper and pin to 2.0. We prefer not to change client-side parsing yet. Also would like ETA for permanent fix.

xia (eng-runtime): Will flip feature-flag for account acme-corp now (expected <30m). Patch plan: patch serializer to sanitize trailing commas and re-run kernel selection matrix for rwd-open-2.1; target release 2025-03-12 EOD. I'll attach logs to INC-2025-487.

omar (eng-ml): I'll add model-side defensive decoding to avoid emitting punctuation-only tokens right before closing JSON structures; will coordinate with Xia.

emma (Support): Noted. Assigning follow-ups: 
- ENG-RUNTIME: enable permissive wrapper for acme-corp (xia)
- ENG-RUNTIME: serializer patch + kernel retest (xia)
- ENG-ML: decoding guard for JSON-mode (omar)
- SUPPORT: confirm with customer and monitor (jake/emma)

jake (Support): Liz, we'll message once wrapper/pin is live and monitor for regressions. Thanks for quick repro.

liz (Acme): Thanks all. Appreciate the quick turnaround. Please send postmortem once fixed.

xia (eng-runtime): Wrapper enabled and pinned rwd-open-2.0 for acme-corp. I validated with rq_0a1b2c3d replay: now returns well-formed JSON. Patch in progress.

emma (Support): Marking INC-2025-487 as acknowledged, working.

jake (Support): Closing loop here for now. Will keep thread updated when patch lands. :thumbsup:
